lines.text: David vows to thank the LORD with all his heart and sing praise to the name of the Most High.
The LORD abides forever, judges the world with justice, and is a refuge and stronghold for the oppressed.
David urges everyone to sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Bethel, and proclaim His deeds among the nations.
The wicked man lies in wait like a bear in a thicket, lurking to seize the oppressed.
The psalmist says God sees trouble and grief, and He is the helper of the fatherless.
